newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open slightly firmer.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open slightly firmer.

text.p: COMEX copper was called to open slightly firmer Tuesday following little feature in overnight trade on LME, although the London cash to three months backwardation remained tight at $143/$148.
July COMEX was called 0.20 to 0.40 cent above Monday's close of 118.20 cents a lb.
On ACCESS, July COMEX was flat at 118.20 cents, traded 118.60 to 118.20 cents.
Tuesday, LME stocks rose 475 tonnes to 122,250 tonnes.
COMEX stocks Monday rose 300 short tons to 49,930 short tons.
Analysts were also keeping an eye on the weather in Chile where heavy snow has affected operations at some mines.
